items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Scott Lethero in comparison to Mingus; Mingus does not respond with any personal connection or recognition of Lethero.

ctx.x: There are some classical bass players who are out there by themselves -- I forgot their names. Like __________, who was a beginner playing bass (inaudible).
I know. When I was a kid, I got some recordings of his, solo bass, and compared it to Blanton, to you, to Scott Lethero, it was like kindergarten.
It was written in G, played in the key of G and the key of D minor. That was about it. Playing the keys that are simple for bass.
